name: How can I compare bathtub replacement quotes when every contractor includes different things?

mainEntity.name: How can I compare bathtub replacement quotes when every contractor includes different things?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Use the same written scope when comparing contractors, then evaluate what each quote includes and excludes. A lower number may omit demolition, disposal, waterproofing, plumbing, finish repairs, permits, inspections, or allowances for concealed damage.

Context: Homeowner reports show substantial quote variation for tub projects, often because one proposal covers only a system or fixture while another includes broader renovation work.

Key factors:
- Exact tub and surround model
- Demolition and disposal
- Plumbing and waterproofing
- Tile, trim, accessories, cleanup, and warranty

Practical guidance: Ask whether labor, materials, tax, protection, cleanup, and change-order procedures are included. Require the contractor to identify assumptions such as standard access, sound framing, and unchanged plumbing.

Elite Remodeling & Design can prepare a coordinated design-build scope when the tub replacement connects with other bathroom improvements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare identical written scopes, not totals alone. Check the tub and surround model, demolition, disposal, plumbing, waterproofing, finishes, permits, cleanup, warranty, allowances, and concealed-condition terms. Ask each contractor to list assumptions and exclusions so the quotes are genuinely comparable.
